title: Measure SQLite work in same-session mark-author lookup and decide whether it needs a transition-kind index
outcome: The mark-author query's SQLite scan cost is measured separately from fetched/decoded event bodies and a source-backed index decision is recorded.
acceptance: A reproducible repository-local fixture measures SQLite statement VM/fullscan/sort work for the mark-author lookup across growing note and gate histories, separately from fetched/decoded event-body counters

The measured result and lookup plan support an explicit decision to retain the schema-free query or propose a separately scoped transition-kind index; no constant SQLite-work claim is made from decode counters alone
